name: AI Eval Droost Oracle
description: Deterministic ai_eval grader that scores the Drupal state an agent actually built, via read-only Droost MCP tools.
project_description: AI Eval Droost Oracle is a submodule of AI Eval. It provides a single deterministic ai_eval grader, droost_state, that scores what an AI agent actually built in Drupal rather than what it said. It queries the resulting Drupal state through Droost (drupal/droost) read/validate MCP tools and asserts on it in code — no LLM-as-judge, no diffing rendered HTML. Every check is a reproducible fact about real state (view config shape, a real view execution and its returned rows, an entity's persisted Canvas component tree validated by Canvas's own validators). A question carries an assertion spec in metadata.droost; the task passes (score 5.0) only if every assertion passes, else 0.0, and a question with no droost spec skips. The module uses only read/validate Droost tools and never the write/eval tier.
